symptom: A year-0000 timestamp is admitted by the v71 offline TypeScript candidate but rejected by the canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 date-time FormatChecker. The validators disagree on prospective record admission; this is a validator-compatibility issue, not a universal RFC3339 claim.
lesson: Validator agreement is an explicit acceptance criterion. A runtime-only valid timestamp can be rejected by the canonical JSON Schema validator, so date-time admission must be tested against both with fixed fixtures.
guardrail: Before promoting a Forward Vault validator patch, run deterministic date-time differential fixtures against canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 FormatChecker. For year 0000 fail closed to the chosen current validator compatibility contract; preserve the lower-case t/z conservative rejection as documented residual mismatch. Re-run repository CI on committed code; offline tests are not CI.
